corrections: Root cause of the reported Attempt 3/4 error: PLC_101.stateCode is already an IntegerOutput carrying the required numeric reporting code; applying Integer(...) to it treated it as if it were an enumeration and caused the compiler error. The alias now uses controller_state_code = PLC_101.stateCode; with no conversion.

The model keeps the brief's explicit level-balance equations instead of introducing a Modelica.Fluid network, because the brief provides those equations directly and states that no other hydraulic law, head-dependent flow law, leakage term, or compressibility term is to be added.

Valve stroke times 0.8 s open and 0.6 s close are retained as parameters in the brief evidence, but no intermediate effective-flow law during stroking is modeled. This is an explicit assumption permitted by the brief because no note provides the command-to-partial-flow relationship.

A small physical floor levelFloor_m = 1e-6 m is used only to cut off draining below zero inventory while remaining strictly below the tested low-level setpoint 0.05 m, so the <= 0.05 m transitions can still fire.
BooleanTable command pulse width is set to cmdWidth = 2*scanPeriod = 0.2 s, following the stated sampled-controller rule so each momentary START/STOP/SHUT pulse is visible to the 0.1 s PLC scan.
The experiment annotation uses StartTime=0, StopTime=900, Tolerance=1e-6, Interval=0.1, matching the stated 900 s horizon and the retained Merge assumption of 9000 output intervals.
